search_text: published ZDI-20-1435 ZDI-CAN-11360 (0Day) D-Link DCS-960L HNAP Cookie Format String Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-12-15 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DCS-960L'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-960L Wi-Fi cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the Cookie request header. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it as a format specifier. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. title: (0Day) D-Link DCS-960L HNAP Cookie Format String Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-960L Wi-Fi cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the Cookie request header. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it as a format specifier. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
